Slop Watermark · Beta

Bulk image watermark

Watermark many pictures at once with your logo or text. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Slop Watermark has these main features: Many pictures at once: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF and SVG; Your logo or text, nine positions, tiling and rotation. It opens Any image.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with Slop Watermark

  • Add your logo to many photos at once
  • Tile a watermark across the whole picture
